source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Buildings as polygons, first-party data-download catalogue

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building with record-bound type/use evidence. Historic England's first-party Data Downloads page confirms that NHLE Listed Buildings are published as polygons via the Open Data Hub, but this selected catalogue window is dataset-level only and exposes no Exeter record, polygon coordinates, or record-bound type/use payload; therefore source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
